headline: US strikes Iranian sites while Iran retaliates across Gulf, escalating regional conflict
subheadline: Three massive blasts rocked Ahvaz, two more in Bandar Abbas, and US jets hit Iranshahr airport as Iranian drones struck Kuwaiti and Qatari defenses.
lede: U.S. fighter jets struck Iranshahr airport and other Iranian sites, causing three blasts in Ahvaz and two in Bandar Abbas. Iran responded with drone and missile attacks on U.S. assets in Kuwait and Qatar, prompting Kuwaiti air defenses to engage. In Gaza, IDF eliminated Hamas commander Nihad Riyad Abd al-Rahim Arouq and destroyed four weapons warehouses. Meanwhile, Russian forces advanced near Slavyansk while Ukraine targeted Engels airbase and two Russian shadow fleet tankers in the Black Sea.

sections.title: Russian push near Slavyansk, Ukrainian counterstrikes
sections.body: Russian forces have approached several Ukrainian positions near Slavyansk, according to Pushilin's interview. Russian drones struck four cargo ships in the ports of Chernomorsk and Dneprovsko‑Bugsky, while three KAB bombs hit Zaporizhzhia, killing three people. Ukrainian SBU and Navy used maritime drones to damage two Russian shadow fleet tankers in the Black Sea, repelling Russian aviation attempts to destroy them. Explosions at Engels airbase and residential areas in Saratov region followed drone strikes, and President Zelensky appointed Yevgeny Khmara as acting Defense Minister.

sections.title: US strikes Iran, Iranian drones hit Gulf bases
sections.body: U.S. fighter jets struck Iranshahr airport and other Iranian infrastructure, producing three massive blasts in Ahvaz and two in Bandar Abbas. Iran launched drone and missile attacks on U.S. assets across Kuwait and Qatar, with Kuwaiti air defenses intercepting the inbound threats. Israeli forces eliminated Hamas platoon commander Nihad Riyad Abd al-Rahim Arouq in a northern Gaza strike and destroyed four weapons warehouses stocked with Kalashnikovs, RPGs, grenades, and charges. CBS warned that further strikes on vital Iranian infrastructure could follow if Tehran does not respond decisively.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The Iranian response has broadened from direct U.S. targets to include Kuwait, Qatar, and Bahrain, signaling an expanded regional confrontation. U.S. strikes on Iranian airports and bridges, coupled with CBS warnings of further action, indicate a strategy to degrade Tehran’s infrastructure and deter escalation. Parallelly, Russian advances near Slavyansk and Ukrainian deep‑strike capabilities on Engels and shadow‑fleet tankers demonstrate intensifying reciprocal pressure on both fronts.
